draft_history_older_hint: Show earlier text you copied (↑ at the start of the text box)
draft_history_newer_hint: Go back to newer text (↓ at the end of the text box)
draft_guidance_write: Write here and press {copy} to copy it and go back to your app, ready to paste.
draft_guidance_write_no_copy: Write here and copy it to go back to your app, ready to paste.
draft_guidance_change: Change or remove this hint in Settings ({settings}).
draft_guidance_change_no_settings: Change or remove this hint in Settings.
settings_draft_always_on_top: Keep the text window on top
settings_hide_draft_on_blur: Hide the text window when you switch apps
settings_hide_draft_on_blur_description: Your text stays for next time.
settings_draft_buttons: Show buttons in the text window
settings_hotkey_recording_description: Include a modifier key. If a key doesn't respond, another app is using it. Press Esc to cancel.
settings_hotkey_unavailable: Couldn't register {keys}. Another app may be using it. The hotkey is still {current}.
settings_trim_trailing_description: Trailing line breaks are removed too.
settings_exclude_history_description: Keeps things like API keys out of clipboard history. You can't paste it again from history.
settings_char_width_description: Making symbols full-width also changes the symbols in URLs and code.
settings_draft_font_description: List several fonts separated by commas.
settings_draft_text_color_invalid: Couldn't read {value} as a color. Use the #rrggbb form.
settings_snippets_description: Press {key} in the text window to insert a snippet.
snippets_empty: No snippets yet. Add them under Snippets in Settings ({settings}).
settings_config_file_description: Changes made directly take effect after restarting.
settings_update_draft_lost: Your unfinished text will be lost when Mawok restarts.
settings_app_catchphrase: A place to write before you paste
licenses_lead: Mawok includes the following software. Open a row to see its copyright notices, license text, and where its source is.
draft_send_hint: Send to the text windows on the checked devices
draft_send_targets_keys: Space to check, Enter to send
send_partial: Some devices didn't get the text
send_partial_devices: It didn't reach {devices}. Your text is still here.
settings_devices_offer_description: Enter the code in Settings on the device you are adding.
settings_devices_offer_automatic: A new device was found. Enter this code under Devices in Settings on that device.
settings_devices_offer_waiting: Enter this code on the other device. {seconds} seconds left.
settings_devices_empty: Devices you have added appear here when they are on the same network.
settings_devices_reset_key_description_n: Use this when you don't have a device that can show a code. After disconnecting, you can add devices again from this one.
settings_devices_reset_key_confirm_descr: All added devices stop sending and receiving. To keep using them, show a code on this device and add them again.
settings_devices_pro_description: Send text between devices with Pro.
settings_devices_pro_sign_in: Send text between devices with Pro. Sign in under Account in Settings first.
settings_devices_needs_pairing: In Mawok on another device, open Settings and select Show a code, then enter the code here.
settings_devices_not_ready: Couldn't get ready to send between devices. Check your internet connection, then reopen Settings.
lan_error_key_mismatch: The device that showed the code has been disconnected. Show a code on another device. If no device can, use Disconnect all devices.
lan_error_no_device: No added device was found. Add another device under Devices in Settings, or connect an added device to the same network.
lan_error_no_target: No destination is checked. Choose one with the ▼ next to Send.
lan_error_unreachable: Couldn't connect to the other device. Check that Mawok is running on it, it's on the same network, and neither device's firewall or local network permission blocks it.
lan_error_refused: The other device didn't accept the text. Check that Mawok is running on it.
lan_error_pro_required: This feature is available with Pro. You can subscribe under Account in Settings.
lan_error_needs_pairing: This device isn't ready to send between devices. Open Devices in Settings and follow the instructions there.
lan_error_receiver_pro_required: Sign in to a Pro account on the receiving device.
lan_error_account_mismatch: The receiving device is signed in to another account. Sign in to the same account.
lan_error_too_long: The text is too long to send (up to 1 MB).
lan_error_wrong_code: Couldn't add the device. The code is wrong or has expired. Show a new code on the other device.
lan_error_internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.
draft_history_older_hint_key: Show earlier text you copied ({keys}, or ↑ at the start of the text box)
draft_history_newer_hint_key: Go back to newer text ({keys}, or ↓ at the end of the text box)
snippets_empty_no_key: No snippets yet. Add them under Snippets in Settings.
settings_snippets_description_no_key: Insert a snippet from the list in the text window.
settings_keys_recording_description: Include a modifier key. Press Esc to cancel.
settings_key_used_by_hotkey: {keys} is already used as the hotkey.
settings_key_editing: {keys} is used for editing text (copy, paste, moving the cursor, and so on), so it can't be assigned.
settings_actions_mawok_sign_in: Sign in under Account in Settings to use AI actions.
settings_ai_service_description_none: Choose an AI service to run @ai actions.
settings_ai_service_description_mawok: Uses the credit on your Mawok account. No key needed. Only when you run an @ai action, the text and the instruction are sent through Mawok's server to Google's Gemini API.
settings_ai_service_description_gemini: Only when you run an @ai action, the text and the instruction are sent to Google's Gemini API.
settings_ai_service_description_anthropi: Only when you run an @ai action, the text and the instruction are sent to Anthropic's Claude API.
settings_ai_service_description_openai: Only when you run an @ai action, the text and the instruction are sent to OpenAI's API.
settings_ai_model_description: Leave empty to use the default model.
settings_mawok_signing_in: Sign in on the page that opened in your browser, then click Link this device.
settings_mawok_sign_in_expired: Couldn't sign in. Please sign in again.
settings_actions_command_special_chars: In a line with {mark}, ! and ^ may be removed or replaced, so the line may not work as expected (a Windows cmd rule). To use them, read the text from standard input instead of {mark}.
settings_actions_description: The text is passed to the command on standard input. Start a line with @ai to send the rest to AI as the instruction. In either case, {mark} in the line is replaced with the text.
settings_ai_consent_title: Your text will be sent to {service}
settings_ai_consent_what: What's sent: when you run an AI action, the text to run it on (the selection or all of the text) and the action's instructions.
settings_ai_consent_where_gemini: Where: Google's Gemini API (the account of the API key you entered).
settings_ai_consent_where_mawok: Where: Google's Gemini API (paid tier), through Mawok's server.
settings_ai_consent_where_anthropic: Where: Anthropic's Claude API (the account of the API key you entered).
settings_ai_consent_where_openai: Where: OpenAI's API (the account of the API key you entered).
settings_ai_consent_handling_gemini: Handling: on the free tier, what you send is used to improve Google's products and may be read by people. On the paid tier, it's still kept for 55 days for abuse monitoring. What you send can't be taken back.
settings_ai_consent_handling_mawok: Handling: Mawok's server doesn't keep what you send or the results. The Gemini API doesn't use it for training, but keeps it for 55 days for abuse monitoring. What you send can't be taken back.
settings_ai_consent_handling_anthropic: Handling: what you send isn't used to train models and is deleted within 30 days. If automated systems flag it as possibly violating the usage policy, it may be kept for up to 2 years and read by Anthropic's safety team. What you send can't be taken back.
settings_ai_consent_handling_openai: Handling: what you send isn't used to train models (unless you turn on data sharing in your OpenAI settings). It's kept for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring and may be read by OpenAI staff. What you send can't be taken back.
action_error_disabled: AI isn't set up yet. Under Actions in Settings, choose an AI service, then enter its API key or sign in under Account. Then accept the notice under Actions.
action_error_no_key: No API key is set. Enter one under Actions in Settings.
action_error_key_unreadable: Couldn't read the API key. Allow access to the Keychain or credential store, or enter the key again under Actions in Settings.
action_error_invalid_key: The API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check the key under Actions in Settings.
action_error_rejected: The AI service rejected the request. Check the key and the model name under Actions in Settings.
action_error_model_not_found: The model wasn't found. Check the model name under Actions in Settings.
action_error_rate_limited: The AI service's rate or usage limit was reached. Wait a while and try again.
action_error_billing: The AI service's spending or credit limit was reached. Trying again won't help; check the balance and limits in your AI service account.
action_error_sign_in_required: You aren't signed in to your Mawok account. Sign in under Account in Settings.
action_error_no_credit: Your Mawok account has no credit left.
action_error_text_too_long: The text to send is too long. Select a shorter part and try again.
action_error_previous_running: The previous AI action hasn't finished on Mawok's server yet. Wait a moment and try again.
account_error_unreachable: Couldn't reach the Mawok account server. Check your network and try again.
action_error_service_error: The AI service had an error. Wait a while and try again.
action_error_network: Couldn't connect to the AI service. Check your network.
action_error_timeout: The AI service didn't respond in time. Try again.
action_error_command_not_started: Couldn't start the command. Details are in the log.
action_error_folder_missing: Couldn't find the current folder. Use “Go to folder” to choose it again.
action_error_command_not_found: The command wasn't found. Under Actions in Settings, try writing it with its full path.
action_error_command_killed: The command was stopped before it finished.
action_error_text_not_embeddable: The text is too large or has characters that can't be embedded, so it couldn't be put into {mark}. Use a command that reads standard input instead.
action_error_multiline_command: On Windows, a command line with line breaks can't be run. Put it on one line.
action_error_empty_output: The command returned nothing. If the command doesn't return a result, set its output to "Don't show" under Actions in Settings.
action_error_output_too_large: The command was stopped because its output exceeded 1 MB.
action_error_text_not_encodable: The text has characters (such as emoji or ¥) that the action's text encoding can't represent, so it wasn't run. Check the encoding under Actions in Settings.
action_error_output_undecodable: The command's output couldn't be read in the action's text encoding. Check the encoding under Actions in Settings.
action_error_unexpected: Couldn't run the action. Details are in the log.
draft_actions_hint: Run the text through AI or a command
folder_candidates_more: {count} more. Type more of the name to narrow them down.
folder_error_network: Commands can't run in a network path (one that starts with {prefix}). Use a path with a mapped drive letter.
actions_empty: No actions yet. Add them under Actions in Settings ({settings}).
actions_empty_no_key: No actions yet. Add them under Actions in Settings.
snippets_register_draft: Save the text as a snippet
snippets_register_selection: Save the selection as a snippet
draft_snippet_already_registered: A snippet with the same text already exists.
